name: Pandemic 2020 v1.0.02
author: HoweToGaming
description: Hi, Welcome to the second release of my game this is how far I have got since installing unity and started learning on Boxing Day 2020. The current game is the first level demo for testing so any feed back would be grateful thank you. The game is a 3d platformer based in 2020 in the middle of a covid-19 pandemic. Can you survive, collect the vaccine vials and the bonus and remember to take self tests at check point on the way the the vaccination clinic.
